outcome: endometrioid carcinoma originating from endometriosis foci in an abdominal wall scar
cohort: A 44-year-old female patient presented with abnormal uterine bleeding, abdominal wall swelling, and cyclic pain near an old cesarean section incision scar.
finding: This case report describes the synchronous development of endometrioid-type endometrial cancer and endometrioid carcinoma originating from endometriosis foci in an old cesarean section scar tissue in the abdominal wall.
mod_finding: One of the endometrioid carcinomas originated from endometriosis foci in an old cesarean section incision scar, indicating a potential link between the mode of birth and the location of cancer development.
